<section_guide number="4" title="Demo Scenario" references="1,2">
<purpose>Close the first PoC iteration with one executable Demo Scenario.</purpose>

<questions>
1. What is the shortest executable scenario, and what visible result makes the complete flow pass?
</questions>

<workflow>
Read Sections 1 and 2. If Section 3 was written, read it too and keep every tested claim inside that
explicit boundary.

Ask the focused question above and integrate the user's answer. Use the approved target user and
Core User Flow. Demo Scenario contains only the starting context needed to run the flow, sequential
user actions, visible expected results, and one observable overall pass result.

Do not require a separate Learning Check, experiment plan, metrics framework, interview script, or
learning decision. Do not substitute a feature list, screen tour, subjective impression, or
implementation check. Do not add product promises absent from the approved Sections.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm the Demo Scenario before saving 4.1 once.</completion>
</section_guide>
